mainEntity.name: How quickly can an engagement start?

acceptedAnswer.text: Single engagements and workshops can typically be scheduled within 5 to 10 business days of scope approval. Monthly retainers and multi-part educational curricula are scheduled based on current sprint capacity.

mainEntity.name: What communication channels do you support?

acceptedAnswer.text: Communication is conducted asynchronously via shared Slack or Discord channels, email, and GitHub Pull Requests. For live training, interactive sessions are hosted on Zoom, Google Meet, or Microsoft Teams.

mainEntity.name: How does runtime code verification work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every code sample included in tutorials, documentation, and training modules is tested in live execution environments (Python REPLs, cargo test sandboxes, go test suites, or Mojo test runners) before delivery.

mainEntity.name: What are the 6 Tiers of Payment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pricing is organized across 6 tiers of payment: Tier 1 Developed Nations (100%), Tier 2 Developing Nations (75%), Tier 3 Least Developed Nations (50%), Tier 4 Startups (50% off), Tier 5 Non-Profits & Academia (subsidized custom rates), and Tier 6 Third-World Countries & Underprivileged Individuals (75% off).
